items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My first group was precisely in the Liborio. I had on the piano, Rafael Benitez, Xiomara Alfaro’s husband.

ctx.x: Oh yes, yes. Her husband is the Panamanian musical director and arranger
Rafael Benitez. Good musician too. Good musician. Xiomara Alfaro, yes. She lived here in this same building.
